title: AI 3D Model Comparison: Trellis vs Tripo vs Meshy vs Rodin vs Hunyuan
summary: Looking for the best AI 3D model generator? Compare Trellis, Tripo, Meshy, Rodin, and Hunyuan to find which performs best for characters, props, furniture, and more.
body_markdown: The AI 3D model generation space has exploded with innovation recently, with several platforms competing to create the most impressive, usable 3D assets from simple text or image inputs. If you're looking for state-of-the-art AI 3D generation models, five names consistently stand out: Trellis, Tripo, Meshy, Rodin, and Hunyuan. Each platform brings unique strengths to the table, but they also share common limitations – particularly when it comes to texture quality and editing capabilities.
